items.title: Quantum 'birthmarks' hold lasting traces of a system's past
items.abstract: Some classical physical systems can explore many configurations over time until their long-term behavior no longer reveals their starting conditions. The sampling of available configurations according to the appropriate statistical distribution is a property called ergodicity.
